risk_and_exit: All-published roster is not physical-world completeness or contact-free proof. New/unpublished hostile units can appear; no route forecast or combat win is certified.

Native29 fingerprints these armies only after the daily callback. SDK event/actor checks act on published boundaries; strong native intra-day event/actor watch is absent. Faster intra-day reaction is not promised.

Any contact/combat, mandatory UI, actor/episode/connection/world change, unknown roster, active assault, date overshoot, missing native pause, speed mismatch, unknown ACK/cancel, recording guard failure or planner incident stops further trial admission. Preserve original lawful battle/event handling; no guard weakening to complete three samples.

Only three exact successful native-paused days plus complete source/owner/recording evidence can support a narrow speed2 qualification. It cannot authorize speed3, active battle acceleration or missing native intra-day guarantees; stability outranks one quicker sample.
